news.title: Radiology Partners完成对Everlight Radiology的收购
news.snippet: 通过RP Clinical Services完成收购，扩展放射学服务网络与全球布局。
news.raw_snippet: Radiology Partners, Inc., through RP Clinical Services and our managed practices, together with Mosaic Clinical Technologies, Inc., our technology and artificial intelligence division, is the leading global provider of radiology services, as well as related advanced technology and AI. Our network of approximately 4,700 radiologists, based in over 40 countries, interprets more than 57 million imaging studies each year for 3,700 hospitals and other healthcare facilities in six countries. Learn [...] ### Combination creates a global leader in teleradiology, extending 24/7/365 subspecialty coverage for hospitals, health systems and imaging providers across the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and South Africa [...] Everlight now operates as part of RP’s global teleradiology business, alongside RP Clinical Services’ vRad unit, the largest teleradiology platform in the U.S. The combination brings together Everlight’s international radiologist network and vRad’s U.S. teleradiology capabilities, expanding RP’s ability to support hospitals, health systems and imaging providers with 24/7/365 coverage across major international markets.

news.title: Goodwin就Unconventional AI收购NeuReality提供法律咨询
news.snippet: Goodwin为Unconventional AI收购NeuReality的交易提供全程法律咨询服务。
news.raw_snippet:
# Goodwin Advises Unconventional AI on Acquisition of NeuReality

The Technology M&A team advised Unconventional AI on its acquisition of NeuReality, a pioneer in purpose-built AI inference infrastructure and silicon. This acquisition brings together NeuReality’s experienced development team, which specializes in systems architecture, chip design, and indifference systems development for artificial intelligence, to Unconventional AI. The transaction closed on November 19, 2026. [...] Unconventional AI is founded by experts in AI systems, analog circuits, computing theory, and neuroscience. Unconventional AI is rethinking the foundations of computing to bring biology-scale efficiency to artificial intelligence. The company is targeting a 1000x improvement in AI to compute efficiency over conventional systems by redesigning AI infrastructure from first principles. [...] The Goodwin team was led by Nate Hagler, Andrew Schipper, Hayden Kursh, Joyce Chang, Kelsey Lemaster, Kate Blansett, Kevin Liu, Mina Matsumoto, Jacqueline Klosek, Daniel Berrick, April Sun, Laura Conway, Cisco Palao-Ricketts, Nate Cunningham, Sofia Polishchuk, Ai Tajima, and Alexandra Bargoot.

For more information on the deal, please read the press release.
